recentItems.title: Ep 149: Exercise Pitch Black in Australia
recentItems.description:
This week, InsideAIR goes 'Down Under' to RAAF Darwin, Australia on Exercise Pitch Black. 

 International exercises don’t just put aircraft and aircrew interoperability to the test. The aviators who move, mend, fuel and feed the RAF must bring their ‘A game’ too, as nothing in the air would happen without them.

 InsideAIR is produced for the Royal Air Force by RAF Media Reserves. Theme music by RAF Music Services.

recentItems.title: A Message from the Chief of the Air Staff | Royal Edinburgh Military Tattoo 2026
recentItems.description:
As lead Service for the Royal Edinburgh Military Tattoo, the RAF is proud to help bring together some of the world's finest military bands in a spectacular celebration of music, culture and tradition.

Chief of the Air Staff, Air Chief Marshal Sir Harv Smyth, shares his personal reflections on this year's theme, "A Call to Gather", and highlights some of the most memorable moments from the Tattoo so far.

recentItems.title: Ep 148: AOC 11 Gp - Defence of the Heart
recentItems.description:
They’re the RAF’s operational hub, they make critical decisions at pace, and they balance global commitments with Air Defence of the UK. They are 11 Group. This week, InsideAIR speaks with Air Vice-Marshal Steve Kilvington, Air Officer Commanding 11 Group, the person responsible for driving operational thinking across the Royal Air Force.

 InsideAIR is produced for the Royal Air Force by RAF Media Reserves. Theme music by RAF Music Services.

recentItems.title: Royal Edinburgh Military Tattoo: RAF Music
recentItems.description:
The RAF is proud to be the lead service for the 2026 Royal Edinburgh Military Tattoo.

Throughout the Tattoo, international bands will join those from the UK Armed Forces in a show of pinpoint precision, ceremony and unity.

In the first of our behind-the-scenes videos, hear from members of the RAF Band in rehearsal as they prepare to perform in the grounds of Edinburgh Castle.
